name: Notice (generic)
notes: Client: cinematic state, input notices. Server: tutorial hint.

name: Vitals (health, secondary resource)
notes: Only to objects with a vitals component. Sent with every champion bundle.

name: Start scriptlets on an entity
notes: Animations, VFX, sounds; key must be in the entity's table.

name: Set local player
notes: At login and again before every later match (the world teardown resets it).

name: Packet: ServerSwitch
notes: u32 sequence; makes the game connection current.

name: Packet: Referral
notes: u64 cookie | u16 | u8 | u8 | u16 port | char[256] host. After AcceptMatch.

name: End room check
notes: Lobby over: the client loads the world (apply 0x8b8a90 -> 0xab9080: SetLobbyTransitionCalled, CheckTransitionToWorldLoad). Re-arms a 60 s watchdog. Held back during a champion select (fase3-iy).

name: Exit lobby
notes: u8 0 | u32 room id; the client leaves the world (answers 0x12D). exit_lobby_delay = -1.

name: Lobby state
notes: Lobby: u8 0 | u32 teams | u32 players per team | u32 encounter | u32 qflags | u64 | u32 my team | u32 room | lists. Teams 0 (tutorials) = no champion select; fase3-iy sends 2 x 1 for Coast City v AI. Apply 0x8b8970 -> 0xabde80.

name: (sent once the local player is recognised)
Account level / XP
notes: Login (opens the landing screen) and scorecard.

name: Skill disable condition (slot, ErrorType, add/remove)
notes: u8 0 | u32 slot (-2 = all) | u32 ErrorType key | 16 bytes | u8 add (1) / remove (0). Keys: 0x1000003B Silenced, 0x10000050 Rooted, 0x1000006B Crippled (only for skills with 0x100007FD), others always block. Never sent.

name: Item statuses
notes: u8 0 | u32 n | n x (u32 DID | u32 status | u32 content type | u8 owned | u32 count). Owned / locked champions (type 1), skins (4) and, since fase3-fn, the 134 Protector icons (3). Flash OwnablesManager builds its lists from it.

name: Sent on Launch (before the encounter overview movie) and after the end page
notes: Empty body; no reply needed. JoinQueue 0x20EB follows about 2 s after the movie ends (client side). After a match ended it marks the end page closing: the new interface brings the launcher back (fase3-fx).

name: Order: move / attack / skill
notes: u32 command (2 attack or skill, 3 attack-move, 4 move, 6 stop, 9 skill) | u32 ability = skill slot (0 basic, 1-4 Q-R, 7 D, 8 F) | u64 target | position | u8.

name: Skill cooldown
notes: u8 0 | u64 agent | u32 slot | f64 end time.

name: Entity attached (local player)
notes: Its absence on a replay meant no local player.

name: Achievement progress
notes: Login (the 5 trainee achievements) and match end (Tutorial n newly complete): u8 0 | table of progress entries | u32list deprecated.

name: Pending reward sets
notes: Answer to 0x2124 (and with 0x211F): u8 0 | u32 n | elements (set, source, -, item, qty, bestowal, u64 instance, icon, name). The client passes it to the UI only once per instance id.

name: Claim reward (Continue)
notes: u32 reward set | u32 choice | u32 source | u64 instance | lists.

name: Ask for achievement banners
notes: Answered with 0x211F. Also sent when the client returns to the Launch screen after the overview movie without queuing; the server then queues it (fase3-fz).

name: Player ping
notes: Patched client also sends RankSkill as ping type "KNAR".

name: (sent once the local player is recognised)
Protector icon slot
notes: u8 0 | u32 icon | u32 slot (scorecard.protector_icon_slot): the answer to 0x2093.

name: Header + protector icons
notes: u8 0 | 5 x u32 icon | u32 | u32 | StringInfo | StringInfo | u32 | u8. Flash GM_UI.RecvNotice_SendHeaderNameAndProtectorIcons(name, icon DIDs, names, descs, unlock texts) fills the header and its 5 icon slots (each opens the Protector icon picker). Sent after the end page and, since fase3-fp, at login with the first 5 avatar icons (ownable DIDs, to be confirmed).

name: Packet: welcome / ConnectRequest reply
notes: 16-byte route id | BE f64 time | 8 | u32 | BE u32 | BE u32 connection id. Both connections.

name: Packet: time (keepalive)
notes: BE f64 time every 2 s on the game connection; without it the client drops it after 60 s.

name: Notice: NotifyMatchEnded (in event 0x2)
notes: u32 winning team | u32 player team | f32 seconds | u32 tier | f32 target time. Equal teams = VICTORY.

name: Notice: cinematic state (in event 0x2)
notes: u32 state | u32 cinematic DID; 4 = ended.

name: Notice: load complete (in event 0x2)
notes: Starts the intro cinematic after cinematic_delay.

name: Notice: tutorial hint (in event 0x2)
notes: u32 hint id | u8 force open.

name: Notice: ShowAnnouncement (in event 0x2)
notes: StringInfo | u32 billboard type (2 text, 9 MatchWin, 11 Team1Victory) | u32 src icon | u32 tgt icon | i32 src team | i32 tgt team | u8.

name: Flash request: character level / XP
notes: Answered from the client's cache of 0x2104.

name: Flash request: soft currency
notes: Cache of 0x20B9. Same number as the wagon behavior property.

name: Query RequestProtectorIcons (Flash -> C++)
notes: ProtectorIconManager.BuidDataArray: every Protector icon's ownable DID (didIconWC), picture, name, description and unlock text, from the game data.

name: Notice UI_SetProtectorIcon (Flash -> C++)
notes: Sent when the player picks an icon for a header slot (icon DID, slot). It goes out as 0x2093; the server's answer is 0x2154.

name: Set Protector icon (profile header slot)
notes: u32 icon (ownable DID 0x40...) | u32 slot 0-4 (seen 15:10: 0x40000E55, slot 0). Saved in data/progress.json; answered with 0x2154.

name: Lobby character lock (probable)
notes: u32 character variant | u8 1 | u32 1, sent in the champion select (2026-10-18 00:23). fase3-iz answers with the 0x2029 slot locked and ends the lobby.
